content.title: FILE TRANSFER & STORAGE
content.content:
SnapLogic integrates with on-premises file storage servers. Supports key-based and password authentication. File pattern matching, recursive directory listing, and append mode.

- **FTP / FTPS**: Unencrypted and secured-with-SSL FTP mode supported.

- **SCP**: Secure file copy read/write.

- **SMB/NFS**: Local and network file system read/write. SMB (Windows file shares) and NFS (Linux/Unix) both supported — Ground Plex mounts shares as local filesystems for pipeline access. Used extensively for legacy file integration scenarios.

- **AWS S3 / S3-Compatible (MinIO, NetApp StorageGRID)**: Snap Pack supports AWS S3 and S3-compatible on-premises object store (MinIO, Ceph, NetApp StorageGRID, etc.). All S3 API operations (GetObject, PutObject, ListObjects, DeleteObject) supported.

- **Google Drive / Google Sheets**: Read/write connector for Google Workspace — relevant for AH teams using G Suite for collaboration.
